description: Source code implementing CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) speed optimization functions, including table initialization, byte reversal, and architecture-specific CRC calculations for 16-bit and 64-bit CRCs, with support for little-endian and big-endian architectures.

methods.name: crcspeed64little_init
methods.description: Initializes a 64-bit CRC lookup table for little-endian architecture using a provided CRC function.

methods.name: crcspeed16little_init
methods.description: Initializes a 16-bit CRC lookup table for little-endian architecture using a provided CRC function.

methods.name: rev8
methods.description: Reverses the bytes in a 64-bit word, optimized for GCC/Clang or using manual bit operations.

methods.name: crcspeed64big_init
methods.description: Initializes a 64-bit CRC lookup table for big-endian architecture by reversing entries from the little-endian table.

methods.name: crcspeed16big_init
methods.description: Initializes a 16-bit CRC lookup table for big-endian architecture by reversing entries from the little-endian table.

methods.name: crcspeed64little
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a buffer using a 64-bit lookup table on little-endian architecture, processing 8 bytes at a time.

methods.name: crcspeed16little
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a buffer using a 16-bit lookup table on little-endian architecture, processing 8 bytes at a time.

methods.name: crcspeed64big
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a buffer using a 64-bit lookup table on big-endian architecture, processing 8 bytes at a time.

methods.name: crcspeed16big
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a buffer using a 16-bit lookup table on big-endian architecture, processing 8 bytes at a time.

methods.name: crcspeed64native
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a buffer using a 64-bit lookup table, selecting between little-endian and big-endian routines based on architecture.

methods.name: crcspeed16native
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a buffer using a 16-bit lookup table, selecting between little-endian and big-endian routines based on architecture.

methods.name: crcspeed64native_init
methods.description: Initializes a 64-bit CRC lookup table in an architecture-dependent manner.

methods.name: crcspeed16native_init
methods.description: Initializes a 16-bit CRC lookup table in an architecture-dependent manner.
